'''hjedi SOLID DeStH 4 LuKe'S PaLs (DLSC)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[hjedi]]
* '''Published:''' 10 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]

* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed FirstMove hjedi DS 2001 DLSC.txt |Download]]

Maul basically kick`s Luke in between the legs as you win.. Seroiusly this deck revos around Maul

== Strategy ==

This Deck is quite simple.
Your mainobjective? To destroy the Jedi and grand maul his longwanted revenge. You can acomplice this trough lightsaber combat or trough dueling. Altough soma oldfashion battle may alswo do the trick. If you want to duel use Maul, young Apprentice and effects like They will be no match for you. But the most fun you wil get is from lightsabercombating. This is where LORD Maul stepps in.

But don’t forget to search fot Neimodians with The Phantom Menace and use them to force drain the sh*t out of your opponent. They will be preoccupide with dealing with Darth Maul to stop your drains.

A few details:
Use Opee Sea Killer to fish-out your opponent’s Are You Brain dead or Controls, Qui-Gon’s lightsaber or even some main-characters if your lucky. Most lightside players will have these cards multible times.
Allegations of Corruption, the same as above.

Use your blow Parried to get a diffrence of 5 or greater, do not use them to make sure you don’t lose!

With effect you must pull out with We Must Accelerate our plans depends on the situation. Normaly i fetch Where are Those Droidekas?! but Opee Sea Killer is useful when Are Your Brain Dead is driving you grazy!

Kill all Jedi and let god sort them out!
